CHANGELOG updated in PAPERCRAFT: apps/server gains an optional --mods-manifest flag: real dlopen/dlsym mod loading at startup into an in-memory registry, default off, with a designed error-handling policy (bad mod = WARNING + skip, never fatal); new testdata/mods_manifest.example.txt; verified live against a throwaway server instance including a deliberately-broken manifest; MODDING.md and NORTHSTAR.md updated (sess-20260825-1938-f6bd411e)
